question: In a code, A is written as Z, B as Y, C as X, and so on (reverse alphabet). How is CAT coded?
question_ne: एउटा कोडमा A लाई Z, B लाई Y, C लाई X, ... (उल्टो वर्णमाला) लेखिन्छ। CAT लाई कसरी लेखिन्छ?
explanation: Reversing the alphabet, CAT becomes XZG.
explanation_ne: वर्णमाला उल्टाउँदा CAT, XZG हुन्छ।
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
